t: Built-in Apple tools that read the screen aloud and caption speech on the device.
steps: Open Settings on an Apple device and find the Accessibility section.
Turn on VoiceOver and try the practice option.
Turn on Live Captions and check that it works in your language and region.
Test both tools with a student who uses them.
Ask IT to confirm the settings can be set through mobile device management.
Connect a Bluetooth braille display when a student needs one.
Check which devices in your school support Live Captions.
